name: g2_singles_lpqi_r10000
label: Bright northern O/B stars on the LPQI-Pathfinder with the final instrument: R = 10 000 spectrograph on the 10 ps IMSE-LPQI array, diameters from the null crossing in 8650 channels
notes: g2_singles_lpqi_pathfinder with the final LPQI instrument (F. Prada 2026-10-09): every one of the 8650 channels of lambda/10 000 over 400-950 nm measures its own g2 at 10 ps; the 6.7e6 cps capture ceiling is per pixel, so the dispersed star is not readout-limited.
PDE beyond 650 nm is an assumed silicon-SPAD fall-off (0.025 at 950 nm); dispersed throughput 0.5 assumed.
